status.evidence: According to UK Companies House, Advancedtelematics Ltd (Company number 14082421) is currently active and registered in Cheadle, Greater Manchester.

claims.claim: Advanced Telematics provides a GPS tracking panel displaying eleven real-time data points, including vehicle status, motion alerts via smartphone push notifications, current address, vehicle voltage, and GPS signal strength, according to the company's website.
The company reports offering a variety of tracking hardware—such as the insurance-approved S7 Tracker—featuring real-time location updates, geofencing alerts, and remote immobilization capabilities.

The company reports its web-based private fleet mapping panel and mobile app features left-side data points that include customizable vehicle identification, tracker names, driving hours/mileage updates every 4 hours, and vehicle status from Advanced Telematics Ltd.

The company reports providing the Advanced OBD2 Tracker, a plug-and-play vehicle tracking hardware unit that interfaces directly with a vehicle's OBD2 diagnostic port to extract OEM parameters such as real odometer and real fuel level data, as documented on the Advanced Telematics Product Page.

The company reports supplying the Super Mini Dashcam, an add-on video telematics hardware device priced at £275.00 that supports a 5-minute plug-and-play setup, live video streaming, and dual-channel recordings, as detailed on the Advanced Telematics Video Telematics Page.
The company reports its cloud-based software platforms are designed to scale with growing business operations to support commercial fleets ranging in size from 1 to 2,000+ vehicles.
The company reports providing scalable vehicle tracking solutions built for diverse operations, supporting fleet deployment scales from 1 to 2,000+ commercial vehicles per client.

The company reports offering commercial fleet tracking monthly subscription plans starting from £7.99 per vehicle/month for fleets scaling from 1 to over 2,000 vehicles, as detailed on the Advanced Telematics Fleet Tracking Page.

Advanced Telematics Ltd offers a reseller network program providing marketing materials, co-branding options, competitive profit margins, and comprehensive training to channel partners distributing its platform solutions.
The company reports providing commercial fleet tracking services across regional footprints like Manchester and the West Midlands for fleet operations scaling up to 2,000+ vehicles.

The company reports offering customer service lines open from 08:00 to 18:00 Monday to Friday and 10:00 to 14:00 on Saturdays and Sundays, which includes sales and enquiries via 0330 111 6520 and after-care services via 0161 515 9115.
